name: Sojourner Rover
description: Explore the story of Sojourner, the first successful Mars rover, which explored the surface of Ares Vallis and studied Martian rocks and soil.
spacecraft: Six-wheeled microrover carried to the surface by the Pathfinder lander.
objectives: Demonstrate a low-cost way to reach Mars and operate a small rover.

name: Curiosity Rover
description: A Mars rover studying the planet's climate and geology for over a decade.
spacecraft: Car-sized rover carrying a suite of science instruments.
objectives: Assess whether Mars once had conditions that could support microbial life.

name: Opportunity Rover
description: The rover that outlasted its planned 90-day mission by nearly 15 years.
spacecraft: Solar-powered rover, twin of the Spirit rover.
objectives: Search for evidence of past water on Mars.

name: Perseverance Rover
description: The rover searching for signs of ancient microbial life and collecting samples for future return to Earth.
spacecraft: Rover with a sample-collection system; it travelled with the Ingenuity helicopter.
objectives: Search for signs of ancient microbial life.
Collect samples for future return to Earth.

name: Apollo 15
description: The first mission to use a lunar roving vehicle to explore the surface.
spacecraft: Command/Service Module, Lunar Module Falcon and the first Lunar Roving Vehicle.
objectives: Explore the Hadley–Apennine region using a lunar roving vehicle.

name: Apollo 17
description: The last crewed mission to the Moon, and the lunar rover left behind on the surface.
spacecraft: Command Module America, Lunar Module Challenger and a Lunar Roving Vehicle.

name: Lunar Module
description: The lander and ascent vehicle that helped return lunar samples to Earth.
spacecraft: Orbiter, lander, ascent vehicle and returner.
objectives: Collect lunar samples and return them to Earth.

name: LRO
description: The orbiter that has been mapping the Moon's surface in detail since 2009.
spacecraft: Orbiter carrying instruments that map the Moon.
objectives: Map the Moon's surface in detail.
